In this episode I show you how I built a simple piece of software using AI even though I don’t know how to code. I walk through how I picked the right niche, then stress tested multiple AI tools against each other to see which one could actually build something usable the fastest. I break down what surprised me, what worked, what didn’t, and why one tool clearly stood out. Then I explain the real opportunity here how a small, focused software product like this can turn into recurring monthly revenue and why this approach is so overlooked right now. If you’ve ever thought building software was only for engineers, or wondered how people turn basic tools into real income, this episode will open your eyes.

Enjoy!
